# ModalButton

One button of a [Modal](Modal.md).

## Parameters

- `label`: A string. The button's text. Defaults to `""`.
- `action`: A string or single-key object (see [Action](Action.md)). What pressing the button fires, before the dialog closes. Optional.
- `primary`: A boolean. Whether the button draws in the accent fill, as the one to press. Defaults to `false`.
